drills.scenario: Appointment service latency and partial 5xx degradation
drills.trigger: Inject 400-900ms latency and 10% synthetic 5xx responses for 15 minutes
expectedBehavior: Booking write path returns deterministic retry guidance
Incident command trace captures correlation IDs across retries

drills.trigger: Force provider adapter failures for 20 minutes
expectedBehavior: Queue growth alert fires within configured window
Fallback provider or deferred dispatch mode activates
Escalation export captures outage context for operators

drills.scenario: Upstream instability causing repeated transient failures
drills.trigger: Replay transient 429/503 responses at 25% rate for 15 minutes
expectedBehavior: Backoff policy prevents unbounded retry amplification
Circuit-breaker state transition is visible in diagnostics
No worker saturation beyond warning threshold
